text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
—Wahahahahaha!! Ojō, you are so 
crazyyyyyy—!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
That's seriously so insane, right?! My 
lady! Let's shake things up even 
moreーーー!!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(What erratic, unbridled strength...! 
――...In that case, I just have to surpass 
it...!)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
That's it!! That sparkling look!! Let's 
turn up the heat! Fuuuuuuuuuuuu!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaaah...!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
In this race to decide the fastest spring 
sprinter! A historic feat has just been 
achieved!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Daiichi Ruby has won the hard-fought 
battle!! A three-generation sweep for the 
"Noble Clan" has been achieved—!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Congratulations!! Congrats~~~~!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(I won. Even compared to her and her 
fierce running――I was faster.)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...Everyone, thank you for your support. I 
was able to demonstrate the pride of our 
clan.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
In our next race, I will show you an even 
more polished performance.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa... ...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
—So damn hooooot~~~~!! This is beyond the 
greatest...!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ojo...!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Incredible. Both Helios and Ruby...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"What I'm aiming for is... What a dizzying 
world it is."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
To repay everyone—to win a GⅠ... I have to 
face those two.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Above all, Ruby's sheer speed. ...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...I have to work harder... even harder.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Faster, I have to get even, even faster!

text_block_list.name: Trendy Fan A
text_block_list.text:
...Man, Daiichi Ruby was incredible! As 
expected of the "Splendid Clan"!

text_block_list.name: Trendy Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Really felt like seeing it through to the 
end... ...Now then, next up is the 
long-awaited Osaka Hai!

text_block_list.name: Trendy Fan B
text_block_list.text: I can't wait to see who wins—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daiichi Ruby achieved victory spanning 
three generations of her family. Yet, when 
I went to greet and praise her, she 
appeared lost in thought.
choice_data_list: Did something happen during the race?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
It appears what you told me before was 
correct.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
“—Daitaku Helios-san... Her strength is 
the real deal...”

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"I felt that if I didn't hone my speed 
even further, I would be overtaken in no 
time."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Going forward, she will likely become a 
wall I'll run into many times.
choice_data_list: Which means... you're my rival, right?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
If calling it that makes it easier to 
understand.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Milady... Did you just call me... your 
rival...?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to us elevating each other 
along this path.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: ...Nghhh!!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
We need to discuss our next race, so we 
will take our leave now.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: !! Wait!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Milady, where are you going? I'm coming 
too!!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I was thinking of aiming for another GⅠ 
next. What are your thoughts, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today's performance proved that Daiichi 
Ruby can achieve fantastic results at 
short distances too. Considering her 
goals, I want to keep her level high.
choice_data_list: In that case, maybe the Yasuda Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The Yasuda Kinen is also a G1, a major 
race that crowns the mile champion of the 
first half of the year."

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Got it, the Yasuda Kinen, right? Roger 
that!
choice_data_list:
Are you sure we can decide that so 
easily?!

Are you sure we can decide that so 
easily?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Tbh, it's all about the vibe!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"I'm her rival, after all! I'll hype the 
young lady up again!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Btw, this is way too fun~~~! I'm 
definitely not letting you get away now!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Thx☆ Sending big luv♪

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"...Who else is under consideration for 
the 'Yasuda Kinen'?"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: What is it?
choice_data_list:
I just thought it was rare for you to show 
interest...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
The runners are the most critical factor 
in deciding victory or defeat... as we 
have always made sure to check.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, the way she asked that almost 
sounded like she was hoping for a battle 
against a totally different "rival"... Or 
was it just my imagination?
choice_data_list: Bamboo Memory has also declared her entry

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory... the mile champion of the 
previous generation. Without a doubt, she 
counts as one of the fiercest rivals.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I was merely reviewing my assigned tasks. 
There is no psychological change.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Now then, please proceed with the entry 
registration.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the next target race was decided: 
the Yasuda Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: (...To burn, huh.)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: (A fiery excitement... is rising in me――?)
